nodes.label: Annual parallax (Gould 2004 geocentric, piE_N/piE_E, t0_par)
nodes.rationale: Plain PSPL residuals clustered in time windows, consistent with unmodeled physics; t0_par fixed at preliminary non-parallax t0.

nodes.label: PSPL/FSPL vs 2L1S BIC model comparison
nodes.rationale: Delta BIC 571.6 in favour of 2L1S for O-03-BLG235 on a shared footing (same points, errors, profiled flux, no parallax).

nodes.label: Blind search stages (i)-(vi): FSPL fit, (s,q) grid, local minima, refinement+emcee, delta-chi2 map+BIC, diagnose
nodes.norm_label: blind search stages (i)-(vi): fspl fit, (s,q) grid, local minima, refinement+emcee, delta-chi2 map+bic, diagnose
nodes.rationale: Data-seeded only; literature values used for validation, never seeds.

nodes.label: O-03-BLG235 calibrate-once-then-fit pipeline (preprocess_binary_data.py)
nodes.rationale: OGLE mag and MOA DIA flux are incompatible; convert both to magnification via joint PSPL calibration. Freezes calibration so posteriors are too tight.

nodes.label: Cassan (2008) caustic-crossing parametrisation
nodes.rationale: Answer to the near-miss-cusp search problem: every trial crosses the caustic by construction.

nodes.label: Error-bar rescaling (per-instrument K, chi2/dof=1)
nodes.rationale: No error floor: bright OGLE points already under-contribute; floor undefined for zero-point-free DIA flux. K set at 2L1S best fit introduces circularity, so BIC also reported with FSPL-derived k.

nodes.label: Finite-source 2L1S (binary_magnification_fs, Fibonacci-spiral disk average, gated)
nodes.rationale: Sunflower spiral chosen over equal-area rings (no central hole); gating only near caustics gives ~70x speedup.

nodes.label: mcmc_fit.FitResult NamedTuple (best_fit, samples, labels)
nodes.rationale: Bundles samples with labels so a caller can't pair samples with wrong labels.

nodes.label: Huber loss likelihood (DELTA=1.345)
nodes.rationale: Fixed delta so no normalizing-constant correction needed; tried alongside chi2/Student-t, none captured the caustic spike.

nodes.label: Instrument kind: mag (fs*A+fb) vs dia (fs*(A-1))
nodes.rationale: DIA flux is relative to a template with no shared zero point, so blend cancels and only fs is profiled.

nodes.label: Mass-distance-velocity degeneracy (tE)
nodes.rationale: Why brown-dwarf-mass lenses are hard to characterise from photometry alone.

nodes.label: MulensModel cross-checks (oracle, scratch/cross_check_mulensmodel*.py)
nodes.rationale: Independent oracle; needed its own convention audit (alpha offset by 180 deg).

nodes.label: Near-miss cusp search problem
nodes.rationale: Multi-start/MCMC converged to non-physical solutions with no 3->5 image transition that scored better than Bond's chi2; only caught by image-count check.

nodes.label: SLURM job scripts (slurm/*.sbatch, submit_all.sh)
nodes.rationale: CPU not GPU: per-walker OS processes would serialize on a shared GPU context.

nodes.label: Per-event TOML config (input/<short>.toml)
nodes.rationale: No literature initial guesses; instruments list with kind/band/K/ld/time_fmt.

nodes.label: TwoL1SParams NamedTuple (canonical 2L1S param order)
nodes.rationale: Prevents silent param-order swaps like session 10's s/q vs piE bug.

nodes.label: VBBinaryLensing magnification backend
nodes.rationale: Frame matches binary_trajectory(); ~100x faster than binary_magnification_fs via contour integration; own implementation kept as cross-check.

nodes.label: Bennett et al. 2015 re-reduction of OGLE-2005-BLG-169
nodes.norm_label: bennett et al. 2015 re-reduction of ogle-2005-blg-169
nodes.rationale: Requested from authors; would become a second config.

nodes.label: Kass & Raftery Delta BIC > 10 decisive threshold
nodes.norm_label: kass & raftery delta bic > 10 decisive threshold

nodes.label: Bond et al. 2004 published O-03-BLG235 solution
nodes.norm_label: bond et al. 2004 published o-03-blg235 solution
nodes.rationale: Validation reference only (s~1.12, q~0.0039, rho~0.00096); also an early-caustic alternative q~0.0070.

nodes.label: find_zoom_window significance cut (5 sigma)
nodes.rationale: Raw-amplitude threshold was unstable and could balloon to the full dataset.

nodes.label: Geocentric JD light-travel-time correction
nodes.rationale: PSPL can't distinguish it, but the 2L1S caustic exit (+/-8.6 min) can.

nodes.label: Session log format (Built / Learned & open questions / Next session)
nodes.norm_label: session log format (built / learned & open questions / next session)
nodes.rationale: Not semantic versions; negative results are the actual point of the repo.

nodes.label: Symbolic quintic derivation (derive_binary_quintic.py, sympy)
nodes.rationale: Removes hand-transcription risk vs Witt & Mao (1995).

nodes.label: Config-driven pipeline (input/<short>.toml -> search.py)
nodes.rationale: Long-term direction: point at a new event's data + config and get the full treatment (MCMC, corner plots, derived quantities); favor parameterized functions over hardcoded per-event constants.

nodes.label: Login node vs compute nodes (hypatia: srun/sbatch)
nodes.norm_label: login node vs compute nodes (hypatia: srun/sbatch)
nodes.rationale: Shared login node; any fit/MCMC/pool goes to srun --partition=small-short or sbatch; PYTHON_CPU_COUNT exported.

nodes.label: Point-source (rho=0, VBBL BinaryMag0) grid scoring
nodes.rationale: Finite-source cost was heavy-tailed (<1% of calls through on-axis cusps took ~half a cell's time, up to 109 s); point source gives constant ~11 s/cell.

nodes.label: Per-trial profiled flux calibration (weighted lstsq fs/fb)
nodes.norm_label: per-trial profiled flux calibration (weighted lstsq fs/fb)
nodes.rationale: Frozen PSPL calibration was biased for a caustic-crossing trajectory (chi2 31,982 vs 1,953 at Bond's params), so fs/fb are re-solved per trial.

nodes.label: scratch/ vs results/ output layout
nodes.rationale: One-time/dev code and output kept in scratch/; graduate code and output paths together.

nodes.label: Shared plotting/MCMC helpers (plot_fit_panels, plot_residual_panel, save_corner, plot_fit_lc, get_t0_par)
nodes.norm_label: shared plotting/mcmc helpers (plot_fit_panels, plot_residual_panel, save_corner, plot_fit_lc, get_t0_par)
nodes.rationale: Call, don't copy; raw residuals with real per-point errors keep OGLE's precision visible vs MOA.

nodes.label: Spawn-context process pools
nodes.rationale: Forking after torch spins up its thread pool can deadlock a second pool.

nodes.label: Robust Student-t likelihood (free scale, dof)
nodes.rationale: Residuals globally heavier-tailed than Gaussian rather than a few discrete outliers, so smooth down-weighting beats Huber/sigma clipping.

nodes.label: u0 sign degeneracy / per-dataset initial guesses
nodes.norm_label: u0 sign degeneracy / per-dataset initial guesses
nodes.rationale: PSPL depends only on u0 squared; reusing another dataset's guess converged to the mirror solution with an artificially tight posterior.

nodes.label: Dataset short-name convention (<survey>-<YY>-<FIELD>)
nodes.rationale: Filenames only; full name is what to cite/search, always looked up here rather than guessed back from the short form.

nodes.label: Variant suffix -no<Instrument> (drop-one configs)
nodes.rationale: Same event with one instrument dropped, for session 21 drop-one sensitivity runs.
